author: Ethanlucky7
body: With wyrmhunt being active ymir is a pretty solid raiding pet to have, for towers I personally liked mammon acolyte as despair hits way harder than arrowstorm could ever hope to but fey cactus tends to be better for horde dungeons, fenrir is an ok option too as cleave is good enough when you're early t10 and more focused on survivingbthrough content rather than blasting through, I would suggest sticking beo up through 250 if you want the easiest time to t11 as most other classes rely on good/ event gear whereas beo can just stack ward and some some follower stats via ascension or gear will carry you

author: permaculturegeek
body:
I've been grinding BeoO since last April, about to reach 249:

Fey Cactus: Great against horde content, terrible against single enemies since action rate is too low (can be buffed, but there are better options).
I use it in monuments, where knowing there's a 95% chance of arrow storm round 1 allows me to skip ward. However, there are combos with monsters immune to physical attack (Arisen great gazer, Orichalcum Golem). I just kill those myself, but as Auriga that might be more daunting, and you might consider swapping out for those.  FC is not good at towers - it lacks penetration and damage drops badly at higher floors.

ASG. The raid monster. The more basic raids are done by the time I finish buffing. As a result, I find raids which are immune to elemental magic (Sphinx, Ollipheist) rather frustrating because the other followers are so SLOW. However, once Cursed Queens started I've made Manticore hood part of my base setup - I don't need to faff about healing from ASG's side effects. 

Mammon's Acolyte. The all-round workhorse for most of my T10. Great in PvP, dungeons, towers and world (horde fights sometimes have you thinking "just use despair, goddammit"). Nekrosis often a 2 shot if it hits. Fine in monus except not as fast as cactus. Slightly nerfed since they removed bolt volley from BB3.

Replica Selene: Get yourself a celestial lute. Then save 30K shards for Selene. Three AoE attacks. Super-buff (T.All+++, although a 1/3 fail rate). Nekrosis equivalent is a two-parter: Rune, then kill, but often does something else instead.

Chimera for endless.

I think I will be heading to hydrus - less reliance on rng/dodgy follower AI.
